query_wording: Compare the last three ISRs. Which risks, ratings, results indicators, and implementation issues changed?

placeholders.reason: The query assumes a project in context; it is named in the turn.

turns.user: For P176619, compare the last three ISRs. Which risks, ratings, results indicators, and implementation issues changed?

text: Last three disclosed ISRs for P176619: seq. 6 (ISR05792, 10 Dec 2025), seq. 7 (ISR07264, 25 Mar 2026), seq. 8 (ISR07766, 15 Jun 2026).
Ratings: unchanged in all three - PDO progress Moderately Satisfactory, implementation progress Moderately Unsatisfactory, overall risk Moderate (p. 1 of each).

Risks: no category changed - Moderate for political and governance, technical design and stakeholders; Substantial for macroeconomic, institutional capacity, fiduciary, and environmental and social; Low for sector strategies (p. 2 of each).

Results indicators: all PDO indicators stay at 0. Between seq. 7 and seq. 8 the targets were revised after the restructuring approved on 11 March 2026 (recorded in seq. 8, p. 10): NRW reduction from 10,000,000 to 7,000,000 m3/year, electricity use reduced from 81 to 60 GWh/year, km of networks rehabilitated from 1,800 to 1,500, DMAs from 180 to a lower target (seq. 6-7 pp. 4-5; seq. 8 pp. 4-5). First non-zero value: 20 women certified as plumbers (target 550) in seq. 8 (p. 5). The dam risk-indexing PBC moves from 'Not Due' (seq. 7) to achieved (seq. 8, p. 8).
Components: costs change in seq. 8 - Component 1 from US$209 million to US$221 million and Component 2 from US$54 million to US$42 million (p. 1), reflecting the US$12 million reallocation.

Disbursement: essentially flat - IBRD loan 3.85% (seq. 6) to 3.86% (seq. 7 and 8), US$7.71 million each time; GCFF 3.61-3.62%; the AFD co-financing loan COFN-C2580 appears from seq. 7 at 0% (seq. 6 p. 10; seq. 7 p. 10; seq. 8 p. 9).

Implementation issues: seq. 6 reports the September 2025 MTR, moderate improvement, and contracts expected in Q4 2025; seq. 7 reports the February 2026 mission and key contracts expected in Q2 2026; seq. 8 reports the March-April 2026 mission, consultancy contracts awarded and more key contracts expected in 2026 (p. 2 of each). The expected contract awards keep slipping by a quarter.
The ISRs do not explain the rating or the delays; the restructuring paper of 27 March 2026 does.

right_sources: Uses the three most recent ISRs by document date (seq. 6, 7, 8).
grounded: Every rating, risk, indicator value and issue is attributed to the right ISR with its date.
complete: Covers ratings, risks, results indicators and implementation issues, saying where nothing changed.
scoped: Names the ISRs compared and notes that target changes come from the restructuring, not from results.

notes: Seq. 8 shows the DMA target as revised; the restructuring paper gives 180 to 90. A new ISR changes which three are 'the last three'.
